topic: Mutual Fund and ETF Fees and Expenses
subtopic: Comparing Costs with FINRA Fund Analyzer
source_evidence: You can use FINRA’s Fund Analyzer to compare the fees and expenses of different mutual funds and ETFs.
answer: To compare the costs of mutual funds or ETFs, you can use FINRA’s Fund Analyzer to compare their fees and expenses. Costs matter because fees and expenses reduce investment returns: a fund with higher costs must perform better than a lower-cost fund to generate the same returns for you. Compare the funds’ costs as part of reviewing your options.
